Q8499.reason: The child has recurrent, escalating anaphylactic reactions to bee stings, so he should carry self-injectable epinephrine.

Q8501.reason: Hobbes describes the state of nature as a war of all against all, while Locke describes it as governed by natural law and relatively peaceful, so they differ on life before the social contract.

Q8503.reason: The Human Rights Council runs the Universal Periodic Review of every UN member state, including its own members. It has no sanctioning power, it replaced the Commission on Human Rights, and it has 47 members.
